title: Historic Walk and Traditional French Canadian Feast
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
This activity is not recommended for children under the age pf 15 years
We can accommodate vegetarians, but not other dietary restrictions (vegan, gluten-free, severe allergies, etc.). If you have these needs, this activity may not be suitable for you.
We have a cat named Odin. If you suffer from cat allergies please be aware of the environment in which you will be socializing and dining.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join us to explore Ottawa’s hidden stories with you at the centre of it all. On this intimate 2-hour historical walking tour, you’ll uncover the city’s fascinating past before stepping into our family home for a cozy, traditional Québécois supper. With only 8 guests per evening, you’re not just part of a crowd — you’re welcomed into our home as a friend. It’s a rare chance to taste authentic cusine, hear personal stories, and experience French-Canadian culture up close. This is truly a “must-do” during your visit to Ottawa.

We hope to see you soon!
